Create dangling images for imported images which don't have a name annotation attached. Previously the content got loaded, but no image referencing it was created which caused it to be garbage collected immediately.

issue_context.title: containerd backend: loading images (from tar) w/o refs discards everything
issue_context.body:
### Description

If you have an image tar, but in that tar there are no annotations to specify what the image ref should be no image object is ever created and as such containerd's GC cleans up all the content once the import operation is completed.

This is a change in behavior from the graphdriver backend.

### Reproduce

With the containerd storage backend:

```
docker buildx create --use
docker buildx build --output=type=docker,dest=foo.tar -<<<"FROM busybox"
docker load -i foo.tar
```

The `docker load` does effectively nothing, does not output anything either.
This is because `client.Import` from the containerd client does not create images for images without an image ref annotation in the descriptors.

### Expected behavior

This should create a dangling image ref.
